newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Commercial Bank plans to form new board.
- Family of murdered Australian nurse appoints Riyadh law firm to represent the family.
- Saudi Cairo Bank and United Saudi Commercial Bank taking steps towards merger.
- Transport minister signs road maintenance deals at a cost of 45 million riyals.
- Industry and electricity minister opens a cable plant in Saudi Arabia at a cost of 80 million riyals.
